newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures cut gains after 5-yr note sale.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures cut gains after 5-yr note sale.

text.p: July 23 - U.S. debt futures slightly cut gains, stayed up, after five-year note auction. Note sold at 6.024 pct vs expectations for 6.04/6.05 pct. Bid/cover at 2.88, $473.3 million non-comp bids. Floor brokers called auction results decent but said market often fades the immediate, knee-jerk reaction to the news, which they said was a quick tick upward.
